#include "shapes.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <new>

namespace geo {

Shape::~Shape() {}

void Shape::draw(int level) const {
    Point p{1.0, 2.0};
    Point q(3.0, 4.0);
    Point r;
    Point* heap = new Point();
    Point* many = new Point[4];
    alignas(Point) unsigned char buf[sizeof(Point)];
    Point* placed = new (buf) Point{};
    auto owned = std::make_unique<Circle>(2.0);
    auto shared = std::make_shared<Array<int>>();
    Array<int> arr;
    Array<Point> arr2(5);
    Array<int>* aptr = nullptr;
    std::vector<Shape*> shapes;
    shapes.push_back(heap == nullptr ? nullptr : this);
    owned->draw(level - 1);
    impl_->refresh();
    int total = id_ + p.x + q.y + r.x;
    auto lambda = [this, &total, level](int k) mutable { total += k * level; return area(); };
    lambda(3);
    Circle c = Circle::unit();
    geo::detail::Impl::create();
    delete heap;
    delete[] many;
    (void)placed; (void)aptr; (void)shared; (void)arr; (void)arr2;
}

Shape& Shape::operator=(const Shape& other) {
    id_ = other.id_;
    return *this;
}

bool Shape::operator==(const Shape& other) const { return id_ == other.id_; }

Circle::Circle(double r) : Shape(), radius_(r), points_{}, child_(nullptr) {}

double Circle::area() const { return M_PI * SQUARE(radius_); }

void Circle::draw(int level) const { Shape::draw(level); }

Circle Circle::unit() { return Circle(1.0); }

template <typename T, int N>
const T& Array<T, N>::get(int i) const { return data_[i]; }

template class Array<double>;
template struct Pair<int, Point>;

void Walker::step() {}

int v2::version() { return 2; }

}  // namespace geo

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    geo::Circle circle(2.0);
    std::unique_ptr<geo::Shape> s(new geo::Circle(3.0));
    s->draw(argc);
    std::vector<std::pair<int, geo::Point>> pts;
    Pair<int, geo::Point> pr;
    return circle.area() > 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
